text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
An earsplitting roar rises from the<n>crowd, echoing
through the stands.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: These cheers are for no one else but<n>Taiki Shuttle!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: That was amazing, Taiki Shuttle!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for that incredible<n>performance! That
was some race... A<n>race so exciting, I'll never
forget it!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yeehaaaw! I really appreciate all the<n>support!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Did ya see that, Trainer? I'm number<n>one! The King
of the Mile!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
You were the first person to believe in<n>me...I did it...
with these... these legs!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Sniff...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh no! This is no time to turn on the<n>waterworks!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
If I start blubberin' now, I'll miss out<n>on those
smiles...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yours and everybody else's!
Cheers.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Great job out there, Taiki.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Thanks! You too, Suzuka. Great job!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Honestly, this is frustrating. I truly,truly gave this race everything I had.
And yet, I came nowhere close to<n>your speed...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Thank ya, Suzuka. You really are... my<n>best friend.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Taiki...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Just so you know, I won't be giving<n>up.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I have what it takes to surpass you.<n>I'll go beyond
speed itself.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
So we have to run together again...<n>Promise me we
will.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Suzuka...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Of course, what're friends for? Now,<n>get on in here!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
P-please... no hugs. This habit of<n>yours is a little
suffocating at times...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Huh? Whaddya mean?!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle has continued to ace her<n>races with
perfect results.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She's conquered the Yasuda Kinen,<n>the Sprinters
Stakes, and the Mile<n>Championship.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She's even taken down Silence<n>Suzuka, the
strongest Umamusume<n>around.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle has what it takes to be a<n>star of her
time—no doubt about it!
choice_data_list:
I just know you can become Umamusume of the
Year!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Darn tootin'!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Just sit tight and watch me bring my<n>dream to life,
Trainer!
